summary: All five targets promoted to exact per-episode records from Hunterpedia's page-level Adapted fields, cross-checked against the chapter pages' reverse anime fields, Wikipedia's 1999 episode summaries, and EBWYH's Heavens Arena comparison. Filler eps 2 and 18 get honest sliver anchors for their grafts (ch 1 p.31-32 and ch 7 p.9-11 respectively) — both page ranges confirmed exactly as stored in the annotations. The Arena climax reorder resolves cleanly: ep 41 = Kastro finish + Machi + two-month training + fight start (53-55, 56 part, 60-61, 62 p.1-6), ep 42 = fight conclusion (62, 55 ability-explanation flashback, 63 part), with the manga's intervening extortion-trio chapters 56(tail)-59 backtracked into eps 43-44 exactly as the stored ep43/ep44 anchors already say. Ep 45 is confirmed as ch 83 p.4-11, 16-18 (Izunavi flashback: Water Divination, Nen-type percentages, chain conditions) grafted ~20 chapters forward, wrapped in original training/Melody-train content. No repairs; the stored 53-63 zone annotation is refined with the per-episode split.

Reverse maps: chs 53, 54, 60, 61, 62 all list Episode 41 (1999). The manga's extortion-trio chapters 56(tail)-59 are skipped here and backtracked into eps 43-44 (stored anchors already correct).

Kurapika's Izunavi flashback (Water Divination → Conjurer, Nen-type compatibility percentages, chain training, life-wager conditions) = ch 83 p.4-11, 16-18, grafted ~20 chapters forward out of the manga's Uvogin fight; the Melody train meeting and much of the training detail are anime-original. flags_for_sean: ep 2 sliver-vs-annotation call: the manga content is a 2-page sliver (ch 1 p.31-32) inside a filler episode. I supplied a sliver anchor (end=1, same as ep 1, so position stays honest and monotonic); if the sliver rule prefers annotation-only for <=2-page grafts in filler episodes, drop the ep 2 anchor — the existing graft annotation already carries the facts. Ep 18's sliver (3 pages, non-monotonic end=7 + continue=23) is the same call but with more positional value since it records the graft's source position.

ch 56 split evidence is one-sided: Hunterpedia's ep 41 infobox lists Chapter 56, but Chapter 56's reverse anime field lists only Episode 43 (1999). Ch 56's synopsis content (two-month reunion, Ten string, In/Gyo, tape permission) unambiguously matches ep 41's scenes, so I treated 56 as split across eps 41/43 (stored ep43 anchor {56-58} untouched). No page-level split for ch 56 exists in any source found.
